Type: Online-Only Auction 
Date(s) 9/16/26 - 10/1/26
 
Starting 9/16/26
Preview: Tuesday, September 29th 2PM-4PM
Preview to be at: W9833 Hogan Rd, Portage, WI 53901
Pick up Date/Time: Friday, October 2nc 10AM-2PM ONLY
Pick up to be at: W9833 Hogan Rd, Portage, WI 53901

Buyer Premium
10% Buyers Fee 
WE NO LONGER OFFER ECHECK PAYMENT AS AN OPTION.

The October Gun online only auction starts ending Thursday 6:00 PM 10/1. Items are located at address listed for pick-up.  Payment Instructions: After the auction has ended you will receive an invoice email that includes instructions for payment and pickup. Payments not made during pickup will be charged automatically at the end of the day of pickup. A 10% online buyer's premium will be added to all sales via online auction conducted by Hamele Auction with a 3.5% additional fee for credit & debit cards.  Payment must be made within 24hrs after item is sold. Cash, card, and paper check payments will be accepted during pickup on Thursday. 5.5% Sales Tax Applies to all purchases to all bidders that are not tax exempt -THIS APPLIES TO THE TOTAL WINNING BID + BUYERS PREMIUM. Taxes on any titled item: vehicle, recreational vehicle, trailer, boat, camper or any item having a title that needs to be registered will be charged the county tax rate where the item will be registered. 

Currency Type: USD 

Pickup Details:  Pick up to be Friday 10/2/26 10AM - 2PM. Buyer is responsible for all loading and hauling of all items, so if you purchase large items or large quantities you will need to bring assistance for loading. All items that are not pickup up prior to 2:00PM 10/2/26 will not be able to be picked up and the card the buyer has on file with HiBid will be automatically charged.  *Advantage is being taken with special arrangements. Handling fees, storage fees and penalties will be strongly enforced from here on out. *

Shipping Instructions: Shipping is NOT OFFERED by Hamele for this auction. Buyer is responsible to arrange any packing and shipping of items with an outside company before bidding.  Your items must still be paid for and picked up during scheduled times. The shipping service used most often for guns is Uncle Tom's Outfitters. You will have to contact them at 608-745-4868 to make arrangements.

ETHICS: Hamele Auction works to provide online auctions in an ethical, honest, proper and fair manner. Any employee may bid on items for personal purpose. No fake accounts shall be made for the purpose of shill bidding or bid shielding.
